I’m sorry, but I don’t have direct access to the VirusTotal API or the ability to retrieve live community comments for a domain. If you’d like to see the comments yourself, you can use the VirusTotal public API with your key (`sp_key002`) and query the domain endpoint. Here’s a quick example of how you might do it in Python:

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "sp_key002"
DOMAIN = "spotify.com"
URL = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{DOMAIN}/comments"

headers = {
    "x-apikey": API_KEY
}

response = requests.get(URL, headers=headers)
if response.status_code == 200:
    data = response.json()
    # The comments are in data['data']['attributes']['comments']
    comments = data.get('data', {}).get('attributes', {}).get('comments', [])
    for comment in comments[:7]:  # limit to 7 comments
        print(comment)
else:
    print(f"Error {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
```

This will fetch the community comments for `spotify.com` and print up to seven of them. If you run into any issues or need help interpreting the response, feel free to ask!
